::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
IISc-incubated radar-on-chip startup (CEO Suchismita Banerjee), commercialising radar ICs developed in Prof Gaurab Banerjee's IISc lab, where two CMOS radar chips were fabricated. Supported by an AMD India CSR grant through the IISc incubator (FSID); MeitY DLI financial approval in November 2025. Prototype system: 'Ananta'.
:::

## What does this firm design?

FMCW radar-on-chip ICs with radar hardware and AI software for drone detection, security, smart infrastructure and edge sensing.
